svg.text: Actual ILP replica choices at each budget (no mix imposed)
Blue = ILP · orange = price-blind · green = cheapest-first · shapes encode baseline RF 3/5/7
24 h days share AZ/region outage draws across deployments; a machine set sees the same day wherever it is placed.
Whole-deployment uptime is not shown. Partial WAN impact remains a stress-model gap; assigned costs are not AWS bills.
